errors.evidence: The legend for the B2B market specifies the units as trillion dollars ("в трлн. долара"), not million dollars.
The description confuses the data point labels inside the chart area with the Y-axis labels. The actual Y-axis labels are 0,00, 2,00, 4,00, 6,00, 8,00, 10,00, 12,00, 14,00, 16,00, and 18,00.

errors.text_span: Линията, представяща приходите от B2B пазара е в син цвят
errors.evidence: The blue data series is a filled area chart, not a line chart as described.
The blue area chart does not have any markers.
The value for the B2B market in 2017 is 7,70. The description appears to have incorrectly merged the Y-axis label '4,00' with the data point label '7,70'.
The orange line representing growth does not have any markers.
The growth percentage of 10% corresponds to the year 2018, not 2017. There is no data point for 2017 on the growth line.

errors.text_span: след това се покачва до 9% през 2018 г., 13% през 2019 г., 16% през 2020 г., 14% през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps all growth percentages to the wrong years (shifted by one year early). For example, 9% is for 2019 (not 2018), 13% is for 2020 (not 2019), and so on. It also incorrectly states that the value 'increases' (покачва) to 9%, when it actually decreases from 10% in the previous year.

errors.text_span: 13,90 през 2022 г. и достига до 15,50 през 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly uses numerical values from the blue area chart (B2B market) to describe the orange line (Growth). The correct growth values for 2022 and 2023 are 14% and 12%, respectively.
